_comment: A frost damage aura on the nearest enemy in a 1-unit ring every 40 ticks, 14 HP plus 0.2222 per level: the same numbers as the base Damage aura with the damage type changed to frost. Frost resistance can differ from physical on individual mobs, so this answers physical-resistant enemies rather than being a straight upgrade. All values placeholder; mirrors the Damage aura's numbers.
name: Frostbite
